text: Seeing error code SE on ORP676 when CSR tries terms override — anyone else?
That's CORORA-R-ERR-NO-SEC-TERM-OVRD. Security check TERM field 05 failed in S0011-GENERIC-SECURITY.
Alias in the log says ERR-NO-SEC-TERM-OVRD. Operator ID lacks SEC-TERM-05.
Granted SEC-TERM-05 — retest clean, no more SE on order 8842190.
